articles.title: Hackers plant GSocket on Linux servers for persistent access
articles.summary: Multiple threat actors are abusing GSocket, a legitimate open-source remote access tool, to maintain access to Linux servers even after patching the vulnerabilities exploited to gain initial access. [...]

articles.title: USN-9056-1: Prosody Community Modules vulnerability
articles.summary: It was discovered that the LDAP authentication modules in Prosody Community Modules did not fully verify XMPP addresses when checking for administrator privileges. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to gain administrator privileges.

articles.title: Hackers use AntiFox AI agents in AWS credential-theft attacks
articles.summary: Attackers are using Alibaba Cloud to host self-managed instances of AntiFox, an open-source agentic penetration testing platform, to target web services and AWS environments. [...]

articles.title: eBPF Rootkits: Why Underground Actors Are Taking Notice
articles.summary: Linux eBPF rootkits can hide malicious activity and evade traditional detection methods without loading kernel modules. Flare reveals how these techniques are spreading through underground forums, where threat actors are sharing rootkit source code, tutorials, and exploits targeting Linux systems. [...]

articles.title: N-able releases security hotfixes for zero-day vulnerabilities
articles.summary: N-able released hotfixes to address zero-day bugs affecting its N-central remote monitoring and management (RMM) platform, which were publicly disclosed over the weekend and forced it to take vulnerable hosted environments offline. [...]

articles.title: USN-9045-1: Linux kernel (NVIDIA) vulnerability
articles.summary: A security issue was discovered in the Linux kernel. An attacker could possibly use this to compromise the system. This update corrects flaws in the following subsystems: - IPv4 networking;

articles.title: CISA flags Cisco BroadWorks flaw as actively exploited in attacks
articles.summary: The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned on Tuesday that hackers are now exploiting a high-severity Cisco BroadWorks vulnerability in attacks. [...]

articles.title: Microsoft fixes Exchange sign-ins broken by Windows Server updates
articles.summary: Microsoft has fixed Outlook sign-in and mail delivery issues on Exchange Server systems after installing the October 2026 Windows Server security updates. [...]
